coverage_notes: Sections 11(b)–(d) and the Copyright Assurance in Sections 11(e)–(f) contain operative defense, indemnity, hold-harmless, cooperation, settlement-consent, and assurance-eligibility provisions that have no faithful representation using the allowed activities. They remain unresolved; recasting them as Use permissions or prohibitions would change their meaning.
Section 11(a) qualifies the Customer Data covenants by Section 5(b), but the referenced qualification is not included in the supplied original. The existing anchor clauses identify this limitation.

paragraph_audit.reason: The confidentiality exceptions and return/disposal duty, and the Customer Data and Personal Information covenants, are covered by the cited clauses. Sections 11(b)–(d) additionally impose indemnity, defense, hold-harmless, cooperation, and settlement-consent commitments that cannot be faithfully represented by an allowed activity. The Customer Data covenants are qualified by Section 5(b), whose text is not supplied.

Sections 11(e)–(f) provide a conditional copyright defense and indemnity and specify exclusions, including exclusions based on continued use with specified knowledge or after notice. These are operative remedial terms, not a general prohibition on continued use, and cannot be faithfully represented by an allowed activity. Line 333 introduces liability-limit provisions and creates no separate activity constraint.
